codes.bad_request: The request could not be processed.
codes.validation_failed: Some of the fields are not valid.
codes.unauthorized: Your session has expired — please sign in again.
codes.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
codes.not_found: Not found — it may have been removed, or it is not available to you.
codes.conflict: This conflicts with the current state of the data. Reload and try again.
codes.payload_too_large: What you sent is too large.
codes.rate_limited: Too many requests — wait a minute and try again.
codes.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, and report it if it persists.
codes.invalid_id: That link or id is not valid.
codes.evidence_required: {category} requires at least one evidence file before submitting.
codes.variance_reason_required: This value deviates significantly from the historical average — add a variance comment before submitting.
codes.record_create_forbidden: Your role may not create activity records.
codes.record_submit_forbidden: Your role may not submit activity records.
codes.record_author_forbidden: Only the person who created this record can submit it.
codes.self_approval_forbidden: You created this record, so someone else must approve it.
codes.record_not_found: Activity record not found — it may have been deleted.
codes.evidence_content_missing: This file's contents are missing from storage. The problem has been reported to the administrators.
codes.record_duplicate: An activity record already exists for this reporting entity, period and category.
codes.period_locked: Reporting period {period} {year} is locked — a super admin must unlock it before anything in it can change.
codes.record_changed: This record was changed by someone else while your request was in progress. Reload it and try again.
codes.slot_holds_untyped: A record of this category without a fuel or gas already exists for this reporting entity and period. Edit that record, or void it, before entering one per fuel or gas.
codes.slot_holds_typed: Records of this category with a fuel or gas already exist for this reporting entity and period, so this one must name its fuel or gas too.
codes.snapshot_immutable: This record has left draft, so its figure and the inputs it was computed from can no longer change. Reload it.
codes.upload_expired: The upload took too long and was discarded. Upload the file again.
codes.query_too_broad: This request exceeds the processing limit. Narrow the filters or request a smaller report.
codes.unit_unknown: This unit is not one the calculation engine knows.
codes.unit_blocked: This unit cannot be calculated yet.
codes.unit_not_for_category: This category is not measured in this unit.
codes.activity_type_not_for_category: This fuel or gas does not belong to the chosen category.
codes.activity_type_required: Choose the fuel or gas for this category.
codes.no_factor: No emission factor covers this category, fuel or gas, geography and year yet.
codes.placeholder_refused: Only placeholder emission factors cover this entry, and they are not used here.
codes.ambiguous_factor: The emission factor library holds two equally ranked factors for this entry. An administrator must resolve it.
codes.factor_scope_mismatch: The emission factor found for this entry is filed under another scope. An administrator must correct the library.
codes.no_conversion: No sourced unit conversion covers this entry yet.
codes.calorific_basis_mismatch: A unit conversion exists, but on a different calorific basis than the emission factor.
